0.1.0.en:
* Runtime: inputs, evaluation loop, published plan and armed control writes.
* Devices tab: house battery, reserve, and the full device list with order and switching
  times.
* "Right now" tab: the live plan of the running instance, in the language of the admin UI.
* Optional availability condition per device, with the value that means "may run".
* Survive a stored configuration whose empty device list comes back as an object — the
  adapter crashed on start instead of reporting what was missing.
* Translations for every supported language.
* The PowerQueue icon from the chosen logo concept, instead of the scaffold placeholder.
* Load the socket library in the configuration page, which never opened without it.
* Ask for the momentary grid power instead of "the meter", and hide energy counters from
  every power selection.
* Confirming a sentence works again: two configuration fields changed in one click
  overwrote each other, and on a meter whose readings are negative the confirmed sentence was
  mapped back to the other one.
* The guided setup opens the next step as soon as one is finished, instead of only after
  leaving the tab and coming back.
* A device that reports its power can hand its current reading to the configured power
  with one click.
* The simulation said "drawing" while the house was feeding in, and the budget lines now
  say that the handed-out power is part of the free power, not on top of it.
* Device cards fold away once a device is complete, and say in one line what they hide.
* The availability condition explains itself instead of being labelled "only when this is
  set".
